adjacent_bug_discovered.title: RegionPathway(plastic=False) / BrainRegion(plastic_internal=False) is NOT enforced by the runtime Hebbian learning rule
adjacent_bug_discovered.mechanism: sim/bridge.py's Hebbian update only respects a per-synapse cp_plasticity_rate_gain multiplier, which is set to 0.0 ONLY for synapses assigned to a NAMED plasticity_gate via set_plasticity_gate(). A pathway declared plastic=False (or a region declared plastic_internal=False) with NO plasticity_gate name defaults its synapses' cp_plasticity_rate_gain to 1.0 — i.e. FULLY PLASTIC — whenever the bridge's enable_hebbian_learning is globally True. cp_plastic_mask exists as a per-synapse array but is never READ by the Hebbian update kernel (grep-confirmed: only referenced during CSR-rebuild remap bookkeeping).
evidence: comprehension_production_organ.py: cp_plasticity_rate_gain has exactly 23040 zeros (4 named cue gates x 5760 synapses) and 1710 ones; 1710 synapses were independently observed to change weight between two successive frozen reads (max abs diff 13.8), an EXACT match — the 1710 ungated synapses are the internal sel_agent/sel_patient recurrent + sel<->sel_FS pathways, all declared plastic=False/plastic_internal=False in the BrainRegion/RegionPathway spec.

over 30 successive read_margin() calls on one process-shared organ (simulating 30 conversational turns — exactly how get_organ() is used in production), max weight drift from the initial build grows from 13.8 to 56.1, approaching the hebbian_max_weight=60.0 clamp, while the well/ill margin drifts from ~0.33 to ~0.35 (a ~6% relative increase) — the calibrated abstain threshold (set ONCE at build time from a small battery) is measurably going stale purely from being READ, with no legitimate training signal.

the identical pattern reproduces in _laneC_source_provenance_opponent_derisk.py (max abs diff 13.3 then 9.6 across 2 successive frozen recalls) despite prov_learn/content_learn gates held at 0.0 — its opponent-inhibition pathways are similarly ungated.
adjacent_bug_discovered.severity: HIGH — comprehension_production_organ.py is Gate-B, LIVE and wired into every conversational turn (`/api/brain-chat`). A long-running server process holds ONE process-shared organ instance (get_organ()) that is read repeatedly with no legitimate retraining signal; this drift is silent (no error, no log) and directly degrades the calibrated well/ill threshold over the process's lifetime.
